test_cases.name: saas_review_customer
test_cases.input: Review this SaaS agreement as the customer. Flag liability cap and termination issues.
assertions: Flags low liability cap if present
Includes executive summary and risk analysis

test_cases.name: nda_review
test_cases.input: Check this NDA for the receiving party. Is the definition too broad?
assertions: Asks or assumes receiving party position
Flags broad confidential information definition if applicable

test_cases.name: pre_signing_check
test_cases.input: Review the attached draft contract and note any blanks or missing exhibits.
assertions: Flags blank fields and missing exhibits prominently
